examples.text: Don't be such a <w>silly</w>, put your shoes on the right feet.

target_lang_translations.ru: Не будь таким <w>глупышкой</w>, надень ботинки на нужные ноги.

examples.text: He was acting <w>silly</w> just to make the baby laugh.
